summary: Studio City International Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing the quarterly reports of its subsidiaries, Studio City Finance Limited and Studio City Investments Limited, for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026. The exhibit references debt tenders and redemptions: a May 2026 tender offer for 2027 senior secured notes (US$196.4 million purchased), full redemption of those notes in June 2026, and partial redemption of US$165 million of 2028 senior notes in July 2026. No new special-situation event is announced; this is routine financial reporting of a foreign issuer.
